why: UX-I-09 — SavesChrome.tsx:161-169 prints the retention rule ('N versions kept. Auto-saves prune oldest first; named ones never prune.') under BOTH filters, which is what makes the session list read as durable. Under the session list it has to say what is true of the session list. Cap source: config.ts:108 HISTORY_MAX_SIZE 100; wipe source: HistoryManager.ts:136-157.

UX-I-16 — SavesChrome.tsx:89-107 counts composer.history.getHistoryStack() filtered by timestamp > approvedAt, and HistoryManager.ts:136-157 resets both stacks to a single 'loaded' checkpoint on PROJECT_LOADED. After a reload the band reads 0 changes on a site that has drifted for days and the summary line beneath it empties out. A number that resets to zero on refresh is a claim about approval drift that nothing backs — say the thing that is true.

why: QA-C-14 — auto-saves persist identically to named ones (VersionHistoryStorage.ts:57-82 writes every version to IndexedDB 'aquibra-versions' regardless of isAutoCheckpoint, plus versionSync.ts mirrorVersionCreate). What a named version uniquely survives is the PRUNE, not the session.

text: Restore from the Saves list always confirms and always saves the current state as a version first — if that save fails, the restore is abandoned. It replaces pages, styles, every project setting (brand tokens, SEO, analytics, custom code) and the element→content bindings; the content records themselves, media and saved components are untouched. Restoring from the activity list confirms too, and names how many later changes it discards; the Time-Travel scrubber still does neither.
why: QA-C-09 + UX-I-01 + UX-I-02. QA-C-09's own replacement text ends '(Restoring from the activity list or the scrubber does neither.)' and that half is now FALSE: ActivityView.tsx:400-462 routes the timestamp through a ConfirmDialog naming the discard count. HistoryTab.tsx:197 (the scrubber) still calls composer.history.restoreEntry directly. Scope per QA-C-09: Composer.ts:576 applyProjectSettings over ProjectSettings (shared/types/project.ts:258-279) and Composer.ts:571-575 cms.bindings.import; the three untouched stores are separate DBs (ComponentStorage.ts:15, CollectionStorage.ts:13, IndexedDBAdapter.ts:14) and exportProject hardcodes assets: [] (Composer.ts:616).
